ASREVIEW_ELAS_U3_CADENCE_MATCHED.provenance: Pinned ASReview ELAS u3 configuration; query cadence alone is matched to the V2 candidate.

ASREVIEW_ELAS_U4_CADENCE_MATCHED.provenance: Pinned ASReview default ELAS u4 configuration with an explicit deterministic LinearSVC seed; query cadence alone is matched to the V2 candidate.

forbidden_claims: prospective confirmation of the already observed V2 result
exact reproduction of the ASReview application or its one-record query cadence
ASReview inferiority as a software system
fitted-model, representation, identity-adapter, initialization-policy or population transport
protected labels, independent custody or independent replay
open-world route invention, closure or task completion

gates.G1_BINDING: Zenodo body, V1 retained failure, V2 protocol, V2 implementation, V2 result, pinned ASReview archive and selected source-file hashes all match
gates.G2_CANDIDATE_REPRODUCTION: candidate order hash, recall at 10 percent and WSS at 95 reproduce the retained V2 receipt
gates.G3_PRIMARY_ACTIVE_MARGIN: candidate recall at 10 percent minus the maximum of both frozen active comparators is at least 0.05
gates.G4_WORK_SAVING_DOMINANCE: candidate WSS at 95 minus the maximum WSS at 95 across both frozen active comparators is nonnegative

initial_seed: the exact V2 included/excluded record pair and order, selected by the retained complete-label-informed hash rule

population.source: Zenodo 10423427 citation_screening_deduplicated_corpus.csv after the retained V2 schema repair

source_adapter.candidate: exact retained V2 whitespace-normalized title plus abstract plus MeSH text
source_adapter.comparator_abstract: whitespace-normalized original abstract followed by MeSH terms with pipes replaced by spaces
source_adapter.labels: include maps to 1 and exclude maps to 0; no terminal is collapsed or relabelled
source_adapter.record_order: ascending retained V2 class-free record identity SHA-256
source_adapter.tie_break: stable score ordering over ascending record identity
